planning.childGoal: Tunnistan ja teen yhtä suuria määriä merkin = molemmin puolin.
planning.coTaughtAssumptions: Small quantities and their compositions are fully pictured/explained. Arithmetic fluency and other symbol lessons are not eligibility gates. Text can be read by an adult, no speech response or forced object tapping.
planning.instructionalForm: Editable quantity model, whole-side comparison, composed sides, reversible side order and spacing, new button context.
planning.stageAccess: Immediate useful action, optional explanation, practice and exit with free local anchor links. No forced step progression.
planning.predictions: An optional thinking pause precedes the model action; no prediction used as mastery evidence.
planning.evidenceLimits: Low-stakes current-state support only. Model/hint/exposure not independent. No delayed retention, formal mastery, physical skill, learner history or efficacy claim. Equality model reveals relation live and is explicitly supported practice.
planning.offline: Teacher notes offer physical counters/pairing and state limits of screen activity.
planning.contentAndHumanReview: Pending separate independent content/alignment review and real human/learner review. Author checks are not those reviews.
planning.primaryComparisons: Independently retrieved primary HTML pages and policy sections2026-10-29; referenced slides/videos/original studies not claimed read. Frozen curriculum_refs are project provenance, not current Finnish legal requirements.
planning.comparisonClosure: evidence/production/B09/astra10-comparison/COMPARISON_DECISIONS_FI.md, read2026-10-29. Selective early model, short purpose and free anchors adopted; no Astra runtime copied.
planning.visualThesis: Open teaching workspace: exact quantity drawing, one immediate action, limited chrome; unchanged supplied raster art.
planning.motion: Manual finite steps only; no autonomous clock, animation loop or decorative mascot movement. Pause disables interaction without advancing; reset restores start.

feedbackContract.semanticEdits: Both input and change commit and retire dependent positive/negative verdict. Explicit check reads visible current values.
feedbackContract.invariantEdits: Separate model step/help does not change a practice expression. Equality side/spacing changes preserve relation and a valid verdict.

extensions.authorScope: Only this KC source package; integration and independent review by main/different author.
extensions.artProvenance: Supplied v2 generated PNG reinterpretation of user identities, not claimed hand-drawn original. Unmodified existing pose SHA matches shared source and current package references. No asset generation.
extensions.numericTruth: Deterministic bounded pure functions; no eval, LLM checking or UI-provided correctness defaults.
extensions.licenceRelease: Inherited human, licence, learner, accessibility, efficacy, deployment and release holds remain open.
